Prostitution is also illegal in Nevada's capital, Carson City, an independent city.  The rest of Nevada's counties are permitted by state law to license brothels, but only 8 counties have done so. Daulatdia | Daulatdia is the name of a village in Rajbari District, Bangladesh which is the largest brothel in Bangladesh, and has been called one of the largest brothels in the world.  It is one of 20 officially sanctioned brothels in the country opening around 1988, although it was unofficially in existence for decades prior.  Estimates of the number of sex workers in the village range from 1,300 to 2,000.  Daulatdia services more than 3,000 men daily; these men can pay for sex, take drugs and gamble.
